pairs.reason: Think-SFT's cut answers are unfinished derivations that finish right ~1/4 of the time, base/RL cut answers are failed searches/guesses
cap hits abstain in the vote; turning them into finished answers adds wrong ballots so votes gain less than singles
late Think-SFT traces drift into Chinese (median ~13,600 tokens) and drifted traces almost never end right; no loops at T 1.0
plain-prompt base has a high early stop hazard; the deliberative opening lowers that hazard
vote converges to each problem's modal answer, plateaus below pass@k, even k reintroduces ties
cap hits abstain from the vote; finishing turns abstentions into wrong votes so votes trail singles
each cell is one Bernoulli draw with seed sd ~5-6; selected cells regress to the mean
stopping is a sampled per-position hazard; cap hits are survival probability, edits scale the hazard
off-format template gives flatter distributions and late drift; Think-SFT's own template is sharper with fewer drifting long answers
edit adds a logit shift that degrades T 1.0 sampling into word strings once it overrides near-certain tokens' margin
RL's correctness gain sits on input-side features in early/middle layers; late band only writes the opening/output logits the cue already supplies
bf16 round-to-nearest drops sub-half-ulp entries so small doses act smaller than nominal (a=0.25 ~ 0.12)
Think-SFT imitates budget-free teacher traces, so cuts are unfinished work converting at ~1/4 and its vote stays near pass@k
Think-SFT learned answer placement/closing inside its ChatML template; raw template misplaces the answer after 'Answer:' and own template restores it
outcome reward concentrates gradient into a few directions that make the model commit and box before the cap
pretraining left a deliberative register that the cue, self-opening and early RL only select
imitation and RL weight changes are orthogonal and superpose: RL adds finishing while Think-SFT keeps precision
bimodal per-problem solve probability; vote converts only the middle band and plateaus; abstaining models vote near pass@k
extra budget pays only where cut text is unfinished sound derivation (Think-SFT ~1/4), base/RL cuts are stalled
single cells are one seeded draw; cells selected as notable regress toward the replicated mean
cap scores unfinished work as wrong; 32k text rescored at 16k equals a 16k run; late-finish yield is model-specific (1/4, 1/10, 1/16)
bimodal problem solve rates make votes convert only a middle band and flatten below pass@k; abstainers vote near pass@k
bf16 round-to-nearest erases sub-half-ulp edit entries so small full-delta doses act well below nominal
a change's effect scales with the set's middle-difficulty band and its cap hits with the long-problem share, so MATH-500 moves less than hard328
